subject.title: Telegram forum: no reliable topic-name -> topic_id resolution for agent routing

question: Which Telegram agent-facing surface should own known forum topic-name to topic_id resolution for routing: an observed topic catalog/list action, a direct resolver, or context injection?
rationale: Current code has an id-to-name cache, but exposing reverse routing needs maintainer intent for stale data, duplicate titles, never-seen topics, and whether this belongs in message actions or session context.

options.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog action that returns known topic ids, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can choose or ask when ambiguous.

options.title: Add Resolver Helper
options.body: Add a direct name-to-id helper that returns structured ambiguity or not-found results instead of silently choosing a target.

options.title: Keep Numeric IDs Only
options.body: Leave numeric topic ids as the supported routing contract and document the manual mapping workaround until a stronger surface is approved.

recommendation.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog action that returns known topic ids, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can choose or ask when ambiguous.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent topic-cache persistence and review history is the closest current-main ownership trail for the resolver data source.
